topics.label: Welcome and Lecture Framing
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture's objectives and outlines the conceptual framework for cancer evolution, stem cells, and the tumor microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic Clonal Evolution and Epigenetic Plasticity
topics.groupedBecause: They examine how the accumulation of driver mutations and epigenetic chromatin alterations confer selective growth advantages during cancer progression.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Hierarchies
topics.groupedBecause: They investigate how tissue stem cell properties, differentiation hierarchies, and specific cells of origin influence tumor initiation and propagation.

topics.label: Tumor Microenvironment, Analytical Methods, and Coevolutionary Dynamics
topics.groupedBecause: They examine how inflammatory and stromal microenvironments influence cancer progression across stages, the technologies used to study these interactions, and the resulting coevolutionary model of malignancy.

topics.label: Closing Remarks and Next Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the lecture session and previews the upcoming topic on cancer therapy.
